descriptor.retrieval_description: Fabric-covered semi-rigid protective case with a soft, dry, textured woven exterior and gently curved lateral surfaces. The intended contact region has smooth rounded edges, continuous curvature, and a zipper seam running along the upper perimeter.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral side walls of the case
descriptor.local_geometry: Gently curved, broad continuous area with smooth rounded edges and a visible zipper seam running near the top boundary
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on both lateral sides
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact internal rigidity and backing material beneath the fabric layer are not visible from the exterior.
